defs.def: a competition in which people try to win sth 比赛；竞赛

ex.s: “We wanted to do something where we do a call to artists in the Bay Area to submit stories for a contest,” Trost says.
ex.t: 我们想做点什么，向湾区的艺术家征集故事来参赛，”Trost说。
A 组织一场故事比赛B.

ex.s: When I was in middle school, my social studies teacher asked me to enter a writing contest I said no without thinking.
ex.t: 上中学时，我的社会课老师让我参加一个写作比赛，我想都没想就拒绝了。

ex.s: A few weeks later, when I almost forgot the contest, there came the news.
ex.t: 几周后，当我几乎忘了比赛时，消息传来了。

ex.s: A few weeks later, when I almost forgot the contest, there came the news.
ex.t: 几周后，当我几乎忘了比赛时，消息传来了。

ex.s: He said that he failed in a 1_______ contest.
ex.t: 他说他在一次比赛中失败了。

ex.s: Before the contest, he competed against a girl at school.
ex.t: 比赛前，他在学校和一位女生比赛。

ex.s: I tried to make him look on the bright side, and he admitted that he had a good time at the national contest.
ex.t: 我试着让他往好的一面看，他承认自己在全国比赛中玩得很开心。

ex.s: Talk about the following: • Have you entered any contests?
ex.t: 谈谈以下内容：你参加过比赛吗？

ex.s: Then imagine that you are entering the contest and write a short story.
ex.t: 然后想象你要参加比赛，写一个短篇故事。

defs.def: a struggle to gain control or power （控制权或权力的）争夺，竞争
to take part in a competition, election, etc. and try to win it 争取赢得（比赛、选举等）
to formally oppose a decision or statement because you think it is wrong 争辩；提出异议
